photo.caption: Pin button for the Minnesota Queer Student Conference
photo.alt: Vertical rectangle Pin Back Button with an illustration of a pink triangle and two purple triangles overlaying the capital of an Ionic column.
photo.description: Pin Back Button with an illustration of a pink triangle and two purple triangles overlaying the capital of an Ionic column Minnesota Queer Student Conference 1994 Conference held at the University of Minnesota, Twin Cities Campus. While the button says First Annual, there never was another one. I am also the artist of the button design.

photo.description: Nine LGBTA student activists at the ticket booth of the Bryce Jordan Center, The Pennsylvania State University, University Park, PA. The rainbow pins contain the phrase "I support student athletes," and the tickets were purchased for an in-progress Lady Lions home basketball game.
